node.title: Re: Diamond errors
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Perhaps fatal [doc://warnings]?

$ perl -ne 'print$ARGV,": ",$_' file1 file2 file3 file1: Hello Can't open file2: No such file or directory at -e line 1, <> line 1. file3: World $ perl -Mwarnings=FATAL,inplace -ne 'print$ARGV,": ",$_' file1 file2 file3 file1: Hello Can't open file2: No such file or directory at -e line 1, <> line 1.
